build_sem_seg_head: build a semantic segmentation head from a detectron2 config and backbone output shape
create_SemanticSegmentor: create a semantic segmentor model with a backbone, segmentation head, and pixel normalization parameters
run_SemanticSegmentor_forward: run the semantic segmentor forward pass on batched image inputs for training or inference
create_SemSegFPNHead: create an FPN-based semantic segmentation head with configurable stride, channels, and normalization
run_SemSegFPNHead_losses: run the FPN head loss computation using cross-entropy on predicted logits and ground truth targets
